title: Tailed Beast Bomb
body:
Syntax: perform tailed beast bomb <target>

Description: A devastating signature technique, usable only while Beastmode is active. Deals real, heavy damage scaled by which specific beast you carry -- a higher-tailed beast's Bomb hits noticeably harder. Works on a mob or another player. Has a real cooldown between casts.

Date: 2026-09-05
